headline: Gemini AI agents reportedly beat Minecraft without human help
summary: Four of Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon AI agents are reported to have defeated Minecraft's Ender Dragon without human intervention, coordinating by sharing tips, threats and mistakes. One report says the feat took 27 hours and involved the agents writing 2,783 programs of their own.
